description: Index of all relevant features, classes, entities, components, and contracts defined in the GPWCF Primary Architecture Packaging domain documents. Links are relative to this index file location.

records.name: Packaging Architecture (Wave 6 Artifact 2)
records.description: Wave 6 detailed design (artifact 2) defining the initial Python distribution model, build backend, project metadata, optional Prefect installation extra, dependency lock strategy, package discovery, and clean installation/build verification profiles for GPWCF.

records.name: Single-Distribution Decision
records.description: Selected option B: one gpwcf distribution containing Core and optional Prefect Integration package; Prefect declared only under optional [prefect] extra; Core base metadata has no third-party runtime dependencies.

records.name: Two-Separate-Distributions Option (Deferred)
records.description: Option A (deferred): Build gpwcf-core and gpwcf-prefect as separately published distributions from the initial release; requires coordinated multi-distribution build/release and version compatibility policy.

records.name: PEP 517/518 Build-System Declaration
records.description: Build-system declaration following PEP 517/518; declares build backend and isolated build requirements separate from runtime dependencies.

records.name: PEP 621 Project Metadata
records.description: Project metadata following PEP 621 in [project] table of pyproject.toml; provides standardized project metadata declaration.

records.name: Setuptools Build Backend
records.description: Build backend setuptools.build_meta pinned to setuptools==84.2.1, subject to clean CPython 3.15.1 build verification; supports wheel/sdist build hooks.

records.name: src/gpwcf Source Layout
records.description: Package uses src/gpwcf layout with PEP 621 metadata in pyproject.toml; source package discovery and package-data policy defined for the distribution.

records.name: Core Runtime Dependency Metadata
records.description: Core base runtime dependencies remain empty; Core-only installation/import succeeds without Prefect, pygccxml, or Generator assets.

records.name: Optional Prefect Extra
records.description: Prefect declared only under the optional [prefect] extra as prefect==3.9.2; Prefect extra installs Prefect 3.9.2 and its minimized verified transitive closure.

records.name: Build/Development/Runtime Lock Separation
records.description: Build-system dependencies isolated from runtime dependencies; build/development/test/verification tools excluded from runtime metadata; separate lock profiles for each category.

records.name: py.typed Inclusion
records.description: The wheel includes py.typed; package markers and exports not created before Wave 6 Public API design acceptance.

records.name: Wheel/sdist Exclusion Policy
records.description: The wheel excludes docs, PoC, dependencies, virtual environment, and consumer-specific assets; only accepted baseline package markers materialized.

records.name: Clean Installation/Build Verification Profiles
records.description: Installation commands and packaging verification profiles defined; wheel/sdist and import-isolation verification profiles established; clean isolated build verification is a release gate.

records.name: Future Split Distribution Condition
records.description: A future split distribution (Core vs Prefect Integration) requires an explicit release/dependency rationale and compatibility policy; not done at initial release.

records.name: Conformance Requirement PKG-001
records.description: The initial release uses one gpwcf distribution with a rigorously optional Prefect extra.

records.name: Conformance Requirement PKG-002
records.description: Core base runtime dependencies remain empty.

records.name: Conformance Requirement PKG-003
records.description: Prefect is declared only under the prefect optional extra as prefect==3.9.2.

records.name: Change Control / Implementation Gate
records.description: Wave 6 packaging proposal; becomes implementation constraint only after review and explicit acceptance; do not create pyproject.toml until all Wave 6 artifacts and governing-artifact reconciliation are accepted; next step: design 16.00_Public_API_Architecture.json.
